answer: A ship gun's shot starts at TransformAffinePoint(class+98h[barrel], [gun+3CCh] world). gun+3CCh is the node paired with the device model's 'barrel' Note (else 'base', else the root); 00859550 poses the root with RotY(-horz) and the barrel with RotX(-vert) every turning-gun update. Bound as kMuzzleOffsetsBound; only the spawn point moves.

steps.rule: search the instance's +7Ch pair vector; returns the pair's second word
predicate: record name equals the key
whole-string compare of record+8 with the key
a Note resource's text lands at item+8, the field the predicate compares
every turning-gun update ends in the node pose
root local matrix; its row 3 is kept
root local = RotY(-horz) with its own row 3 (barrel present)
barrel local matrix; its row 3 is kept
barrel local = RotX(-vert) with its own row 3
no barrel: root local = RotX * RotY, row-3 xyz restored
refresh [gun+3CCh] world before the copy at node+0F0h
offset transformed by the node world: the spawn point

substitutions: a Note is paired with the Hierarchy item whose resources list holds its index (inferred from data; the +7Ch vector's producer is unread)
Hierarchy item 0 is [model+0Ch]; Item matrices are parent-relative
the host's horizontal angle is negated to the image convention (the host's angle is mirrored, docs/MUZZLE_OFFSETS.md section 2)
node composition by 00413920 rather than 00B6DB70's own affine compose
recoil (0085A270's barrel loop) and the [gun+3Ch] slot-8Ch/94h override not applied
shot direction stays the host's angle direction, not the node's row 2
unbound: devices with no Mesh or no Hierarchy (keep the mount, the image's empty-list fallback)

finding: The host's gun horizontal angle is the negative of the image's: 00521370 is atan2(x, z) (005213A7..005213AC) and 008FDAF0 subtracts it from -0.0f, while the host uses +atan2(right, forward) with arcs loaded unnegated.
